commands.title: CoreTrace: View Function in Stack Visualizer

ctrace.compileCommandsPath.description: Path to compile_commands.json. When empty, it is auto-detected in the workspace root, the CMake Tools build directory, or build/.

ctrace.analysis.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time allowed to analyse a single file before ctrace is stopped.

ctrace.workspace.incremental.description: In workspace scans, only analyse files that changed since their last analysis and reuse the cached results of the others. Editing a header, compile_commands.json, the ctrace binary or the analysis options invalidates the cache. Run "Clear Analysis Cache" to force a full scan.

ctrace.analysis.autoEntryPoints.description: In single-file mode, pass every function of the file as an entry point.

ctrace.analysis.stackLimit.description: Stack size limit passed to ctrace as --stack-limit (e.g. 8192 or 8KiB).

ctrace.analysis.resourceCrossTu.description: Inter-procedural resource analysis across translation units. "default" lets ctrace decide.

ctrace.models.escapeModel.description: Path to a custom escape model passed as --escape-model.

ctrace.models.bufferModel.description: Path to a custom buffer model passed as --buffer-model.

ctrace.models.resourceModel.description: Path to a custom resource model passed as --resource-model.

ctrace.performance.compdbFast.description: Use the fast compilation-database mode of the stack analyzer.

ctrace.performance.compileIrCacheDir.description: Directory where the stack analyzer caches compiled IR.

ctrace.cache.resourceSummaryDir.description: Directory used to cache resource summaries between runs.

ctrace.cache.memoryOnly.description: Keep resource summaries in memory only (no disk cache).

scripts.compile: npm run copy-lucide && node --check media/main.js && node --check media/stackTree.js && tsc -p ./
